svg.text: TEXT METRICS COME FROM THE CALLER.
FONT, WEIGHT, COLOR AND TRACKING INHERIT.
DIGIT SLOT IS SIZED BY A HIDDEN GLYPH.
WINDOW IS ABSOLUTE; IT DOES NOT ADD HEIGHT.
THREE TEN-GLYPH CYCLES MAKE A STRIP.
TARGET RESTS IN THE MIDDLE CYCLE.
SYMBOLS NEVER ROLL; DIGIT POSITIONS PERSIST.
CHANGED DIGITS ROLL; ADDED COLUMNS GROW.
REDUCED MOTION SETTLES THE VALUE AT ONCE.
NO FRAME, SHADOW OR RADIUS IS ADDED.
LINES ON THIS SHEET EXPLAIN BOXES ONLY.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · TYPOGRAPHY AND HUG WIDTHS ARE CALLER-DEFINED
W · HUG = DIGIT ADVANCES + SYMBOL ADVANCES
INLINE-FLEX · BASELINE · NOWRAP · TABULAR NUMERALS · DIR = LTR
NO INTERNAL GAP; INHERITED LETTER-SPACING MAY CHANGE ADVANCES.
STRIP: TOP = S1, LEFT = 0; Y TRANSLATE = Y1.
NET CELL ORIGIN: −S1 + S1 + Y1 = Y1.
ENLARGED EM GEOMETRY · WD SHOWN SCHEMATICALLY
COMPRESSED REPEATS · EACH CYCLE HAS TEN GLYPHS
P = D + 10; D IS THE TARGET DIGIT.
GLYPH AT ROW J = GLYPHS[J MOD 10].
SYMBOLS KEEP FORMATTED ORDER · INTEGERS KEY BY PLACE; FRACTIONS BY INDEX
ENTER / EXIT: WIDTH 0 ↔ HUG, OPACITY 0 ↔ 1 OVER T2. GROUP SEPARATORS RETAIN THEIR PLACE.
globals.css duration tokens; six JSX uses across four files.
Browser F = 36: H1 = 50.391; H2 = 69.828 CSS px.
Subpixel layout rounds nominal H1 = 50.4; H2 = 69.84.
Glyph advance measured, never promoted to a fixed width.
No roll / blur / mask; value snaps
CSS GAP / BLUR / EXIT VARIABLES ARE DECLARED;
THE JS PRESENCE PATH USES T2 AND BL ABOVE.
DURATION PROP OVERRIDES T1; TOKEN SCALE APPLIES.
